summary: Two-column time picker wheel: rows curve on a cylinder, flings carry inertia and snap to a value that submits as HH:MM.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected time as `HH:MM` (24-hour). Hours clamp to 0–23 and minutes round to the nearest `step`. Observed: a change animates both columns to the new time without firing `change`. Reflects the current selection.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Minute increment, rounded and clamped to 1–30. The minute column shows multiples of `step` below 60. Observed: the minute column is rebuilt and the time rounded to the new step.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text above the wheel; it also names the group of both columns. Observed.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name used when the element is inside a form.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Presence attribute. Disables both columns; a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>` does the same.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires once, after both columns have stopped, when the wheel settles on a new value after a drag, fling, wheel scroll or key press. `value` is `HH:MM`. Not fired when `value` is set from code.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The selected time as `HH:MM`, including a time the columns are still moving to. Setting it updates the getter and the `value` attribute at once, then animates the columns.

properties.name: name
properties.description: The `name` attribute. There is no setter; set the attribute instead.

keyboard.action: Select the previous or next value in the focused column. Values wrap around.
Move three values back or forward in the focused column.
Go to the first or last value of the focused column: 00, and 23 or the last minute.

accessibility: The two columns form a `role="group"` named by the visible label.
Each column is focusable with `role="spinbutton"` and `aria-label` `Hours` or `Minutes`.
Columns expose `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax` and an `aria-valuetext` such as `9 hours` or `30 minutes`.
The digits are text in an `aria-hidden` layer over the canvas, so the ARIA values on the columns are the text alternative.
motion: With reduced motion, flings stop without inertia, columns jump to the target value instead of springing, and the value label changes without the roll.
form: Submits the time as `HH:MM` under `name`. There is no validation. Form reset restores the time from the first connect; `disabled` or a disabled fieldset takes the columns out of use.
notes: Fixed size: the wheel is 236px wide and 188px tall, and the host is `inline-block`.
The digits are set in the mono font with tabular figures; the selection band behind them is a dotted field.
Clicking a row without dragging snaps to that row; a mouse wheel or trackpad scrolls the column under the pointer.

Setting `value` animates the columns without a `change` event. After a key press or a click on a row, the getter reports the target at once, while the attribute and `aria-valuenow` update when the column settles.
